title: Twitter Performance Analysis - Jan 31st - Oct 30th 2022
body:
Below is a Performance Overview of our Twitter posts for our Edgeware DAO.
Continued thank you to Gagan for his monthly tracking and posting of our data...

Please see the link for his excel report: [https://onedrive.live.com/view.aspx?resid=4326C4CAE1B046BA!35406&ithint=file%2cxlsx&authkey=!AOfEK026AJmRO8g](https://onedrive.live.com/view.aspx?resid=4326C4CAE1B046BA!35406&ithint=file%2cxlsx&authkey=!AOfEK026AJmRO8g)
The visuals below, are an overview of our Twitter Performance categorized and compared by the following:

· **Average Engagement Rate**
· **Replies & Quotes**
· **Retweets**
· **URL Clicks**
· **Profile Clicks**
· **Favorites**
· **Engagements**
· **Impressions**



![](https://commonwealth-uploads.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/10a0cfed-b12b-4798-9b5d-b950223e1525.1668395745285)


Since August...
Our overall Engagement Rate% has increased from _3.76%_ to _3.84%_
1. Tweets related our **Features,** continues to leads our _Engagement rate. ( _≈ _6% )_
2. Tweets related to our **Services**, leads our _Replies, Quotes and Retweets. _
3. Tweets related to our **Operations **we provide leads our _URL, Profile clicks and Total Engagements_




![](https://commonwealth-uploads.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/abfd0781-4142-41aa-8841-da6fb1eebe6f.1668396045173)



Above is a comparison of our _Impressions** **_by Type.



![](https://commonwealth-uploads.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/24e031cc-8357-4917-89e2-26327d57f798.1668396067876)



Above is a comparison of our _Engagements_ by Type.



![](https://commonwealth-uploads.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/a002ec6e-f5ae-45d8-b7a9-3a620301b959.1668396100087)



Notable: Despite our decrease in _**Impressions **since August_ our DAO has increased our average engagement rate from approx _4.0% _to _4.4%._

1. [Aug-Sept] Monthly **_Impression_ **decrease: _5,925_
2. _**Engagement ** _increase ≈  _4.0% _to ≈ _4.2%_ 


     2.      [Sept-Oct] Monthly _**Impression**_ decrease: _4,210_
1. _**Engagement ** _increase  ≈ _4.2%_ to  ≈ _4.4%_
